'''April 2001 Pleasanton tournament (21 April)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Warmasters, Pleasanton, California on 21 April 2001. [[Kyle Ishimaru]] won it. It is known from Michael Mendoza's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2121">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-22-dpc-warmup-in-ca-4-21-01d2121/ dpc-warmup-in-ca-4-21-01], DeckTech (Michael "Longshot" Mendoza, 22 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-22-dpc-warmup-in-ca-4-21-01d2121/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Warmasters, Pleasanton, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Kyle Ishimaru]]
